site.name: Know Brampton
site.tagline: Independent guide · not the City of Brampton
site.disclaimer: This site is not affiliated with or endorsed by the City of Brampton. Every figure links to its source.
site.dataPulled: Data last pulled {date} from the City of Brampton GeoHub and the City Clerk's certified candidate list.

home.headline: You get four votes. Three in four Bramptonians used none.
home.standfirst: A plain-language guide to who is running, what the City actually does with $1.38 billion a year, and what the next four years decide. Built on Brampton's own open data, with every number traced to its source.
home.advanceNote: Advance voting opens in {days} days — 9, 10, 11, 16 and 17 October.
home.advanceOpenNote: Advance voting is open now — any location, any ward.
home.ballotTitle: Your ballot has four questions on it
home.ballotSub: Most people only know about the first one.
home.pairNote: Questions 2 and 3 are decided by your ward pair, not your ward alone.
home.turnoutTitle: Fewer than one in four eligible Bramptonians voted last time.
home.turnoutBody: The Ontario municipal average was 32.9%. A city councillor here can win a seat representing roughly 130,000 residents on a few thousand votes — which is why the four people on your ballot are the easiest politicians in Canada to influence, and the hardest to find information about.
home.addressHelp: Returns your ward, your ward pair, the races you vote in and where to vote. The lookup runs in your browser — your address is never sent anywhere.
home.fieldNote: {n} certified candidates are contesting the 11 seats on city council.

ballot.mayorBody: Runs council and holds strong-mayor powers over the budget.
ballot.regionalBody: Sits at Peel Region too — water, waste, the police budget, housing.
ballot.cityBody: City hall only — roads, transit, parks, fire, recreation, bylaw.
ballot.trusteeBody: Your board: Peel, Dufferin-Peel Catholic, Viamonde or MonAvenir.

ward.title: Your ward and your ballot
ward.youLiveIn: You live in Ward {ward}. You vote with Ward {partner}.
ward.intro: Four races, four votes. Here is exactly what is on your ballot and where to put it.
ward.advanceTitle: Vote early · any location, any ward
ward.waitLive: Live wait time appears here while polls are open — the City publishes it.
ward.dayTitle: Election day · 26 October, assigned poll only
ward.dayBody: On election day you must attend the poll assigned to your address. These are the Ward {ward} locations — your voter card names which one is yours.
ward.notFound: We could not match that to a Brampton ward. Check the spelling, or tap your ward on the map.
ward.tapMap: Or tap your ward on the map
ward.confirmNote: Always confirm your assigned poll on your voter information card or at brampton.ca.
ward.mapLabel: Map of Brampton's ten wards — choose yours
ward.finderIntro: Brampton has ten wards, paired into five electoral areas. Find yours and we will show you every race on your ballot and where to vote.
ward.addressSoon: Address and postal-code lookup is coming next. For now, use your location or tap the map — both resolve on your device, so nothing about where you live is sent anywhere.

sourcing.emptyExplain: No published position located. We quote what candidates publish and leave the rest visibly empty.

translation.machineDraft: This page was machine translated and is awaiting review by a Punjabi-speaking editor. Candidate quotes always stay in their original language.
translation.glossaryTitle: Some words stay in English — deliberately
translation.glossaryBody: Several municipal terms have no settled Punjabi form. Rather than mistranslate them, we show both.
